entries.title: MPS Mathematical Sciences Research Programs (NSF 26-520)
entries.description: Supports numerical and computational mathematics, including work on partial differential equations.
entries.eligibility: An eligible organization submits. The PhD student should discuss a role and the submission route with their advisor.

entries.title: Individual Research Grants
entries.description: Project grants across disciplines, including materials and catalysis.
entries.eligibility: Normally requires a completed doctorate and a qualifying German research institution.

entries.title: ESRC applicant-led: explore awards
entries.eligibility: An eligible UK host is required, and more than half the research focus and effort must be in the social sciences remit.

entries.title: Hilldale Undergraduate/Faculty Research Fellowship
entries.description: Supports undergraduate research. Applications open December 14, 2026.
entries.eligibility: UW–Madison undergraduates with at least junior standing need a collaborating UW–Madison faculty or staff advisor.

entries.title: ASHRAE Graduate Student Grant-in-Aid Award
entries.description: Supports graduate research relevant to building systems and HVAC&R. The published submission deadline is 8:00 a.m. EST.
entries.eligibility: A faculty advisor submits on behalf of a full-time graduate student. Confirm that the architecture project fits the technical scope.
